statement: ∀ d : ℕ, Odd d → Nat.Coprime 2 d ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, d ∣ p+2 ↔ ((p:ZMod d) = -(2:ZMod d))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 短长除数与奇偶 · TP-0029 · 确定 −2 是每个奇模数的约化类
plain_statement.en: New route · Short and long divisors · TP-0029 · Certify minus two as a unit for every odd modulus

brief.zh: 模 d 化整除关系，d=1 的平凡环亦包含在内。
brief.en: Reduce divisibility modulo d, including the trivial ring at d=1.
